name: legal_separation_status
native_rule_basis: Official SARA v2 statutes/prolog/section7703.pl s7703_a_2: a legal separation of the marriage with a decree start before the queried year-end; no extra ongoing/end predicate.
source_quote: (2) an individual legally separated from his spouse under a decree of divorce or of separate maintenance shall not be considered as married.
